newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney on airlines.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney on airlines.

text.p: Smith Barney said it believes the U.S. airline industry is "experiencing peak earnings," a Smith Barney source said.
-- said believes the second half of this year is expected to be "somewhat difficult."
-- said earnings estimates for the current quarter have been adjusted downward recently.

-- said the industry is expected to show relatively strong traffic for June, offset by an increase in discounts and believes there is more negative news in the short-term than positive news, suspects shares will remain under some pressure.
-- said several major airlines have unsuccessfully tried to raise fares over the past two weeks. Said coach fares are almost 10 percent below last year's level.
-- said tax proposals emerging from Congress could raise taxes for the industry.
-- said the tax concerns come at a time when major airlines are ordering aircraft.
-- "Once again, the industry seems to be ordering aircraft at the peak of the cycle," the source said.
-- said Northwest Airlines Corp is its top pick for this year. Northwest shares were trading up 1/4 at 36-1/8.
